prompt: I changed packages/services/Car/service/src/com/android/car/power/CarPowerManagementService.java. Which test modules should I run before uploading: the presubmit tests that TEST_MAPPING files ask for, and the instrumentation test of the app that builds this file? Give the atest command line. reference_answer: Presubmit: CarServicePowerUnitTest (service/TEST_MAPPING) and CarServiceHostUnitTest (packages/services/Car/TEST_MAPPING, host); instrumentation: CarServiceTest (instrumentation_for CarServiceUpdatable, which builds the file via filegroup car-service-srcs). atest CarServicePowerUnitTest CarServiceTest CarServiceHostUnitTest
